name: Network Discovery
description: Scan your subnets for devices not in the Kea lease table. Detects rogue devices, shows discovered hostnames, and alerts on new unknowns. Requires nmap on the Jen host.
author: Matthew Thibodeau
db_migrations: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS nd_scan_jobs (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, subnet_id INT NOT NULL, started_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, finished_at DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'running', hosts_found INT DEFAULT 0, rogue_count INT DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS nd_scan_results (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, job_id INT NOT NULL, ip VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL, mac VARCHAR(17), hostname VARCHAR(255), in_kea TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, rogue TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, discovered_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

name: IPAM Lite
description: Full IP address space management for Kea-managed AND unmanaged subnets. See every IP in each subnet — available, dynamic, reserved, or statically noted. Track non-DHCP backend networks that Kea doesn't manage, with manual hostname/MAC per address. Add labels, owners, and notes to any address. Export to CSV. Replaces Netbox for simple static IP tracking.
author: Matthew Thibodeau
db_migrations: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ipam_static_entries (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, ip VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL, subnet_id INT NOT NULL, label VARCHAR(100), owner VARCHAR(100), notes TEXT, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ipam_assignment_history (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, ip VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL, subnet_id INT NOT NULL, label VARCHAR(100), owner VARCHAR(100), action VARCHAR(20), acted_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, acted_by VARCHAR(100))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ipam_subnets (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, cidr VARCHAR(18) NOT NULL, description TEXT, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
ALTER TABLE ipam_static_entries ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS subnet_kind ENUM('kea','ipam') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'kea' AFTER ip
ALTER TABLE ipam_static_entries ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS hostname VARCHAR(255) NULL AFTER notes
ALTER TABLE ipam_static_entries ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS mac VARCHAR(17) NULL AFTER hostname
ALTER TABLE ipam_static_entries ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_static TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 AFTER mac
ALTER TABLE ipam_static_entries DROP INDEX IF EXISTS ip
ALTER TABLE ipam_static_entries ADD UNIQUE KEY IF NOT EXISTS uniq_ip_kind_subnet (ip, subnet_kind, subnet_id)
ALTER TABLE ipam_static_entries ADD INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_kind_subnet (subnet_kind, subnet_id)
ALTER TABLE ipam_assignment_history ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS subnet_kind ENUM('kea','ipam') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'kea' AFTER ip
